fields.headline: Smoke advisory: unhealthy air from the Cinder Creek Fire
fields.areas: Calloway Falls, Mill Valley and the Cinder Canyon foothills

guidance.advice: Limit time outdoors; keep windows closed; use a well-fitted N95 respirator if you must be outside.

guidance.group: Children, older adults, pregnant people and people with heart or lung disease
guidance.advice: Stay indoors with filtered air and follow your care plan.
Follow your local air quality plan for indoor activity, closure or cancellation.

fields.cleanAir: Calloway Public Library and Mill Valley Community Center, 9 AM to 7 PM.
fields.basis: Based on sensor readings in Calloway Falls and the smoke forecast from the fire weather office.
